name: Second release-gate pool pin and host failover
trigger: Run the gate with node-b and mshq image fingerprints, then inject one host loss or both host losses.
observe: same pinned digest eligibility across both pools
surviving pool receives retried shards after one host loss
both-host loss ends as measurement unavailable
gate hosts are excluded from the concurrent harness task pool
expected: both matching pools participate; one failed host is removed and the other completes the sweep; two failed hosts never produce a reduced-roster pass; image digest mismatch is refused
